items.html: Since the aspect of AV is in the head of AK, being the aspect of the Mochin, and their place is on the inside, opposite the place of the forehead, there the Mochin, which are the aspect of AV, coupled with the aspect of SAG, which are the Achoraim of the Taamim of SAG, that are below the Mochin at the end of the head. Therefore, from the abundance of light that is there in this forehead through the above coupling, a new light went out from it downward, which is the new name Mah.
